items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Duffy Jackson who was the drummer on it... John Coliani, the pianist did a trio with Duffy Jackson, and the three of us. That was funny. That was a funny experience, I mean just being on the road with Duffy was something right there.

ctx.x: What other good musicians are down in your area? I know Ira Sullivan’s down there.
Ira Sullivan, Duffy Jackson, Eddie Higgins, Eric Alison, Pete Minger — now you’ve got me on the spot.
Well that’s okay. Did you ever do that gig at the Bread of Life? You know that place?
